policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O API changelog: security/compliance improvements
items.summary: O’s API changelog shows October 2026 updates, including HIPAA compliance support and platform connectivity changes (e.g., IPv6). Continued API hardening can improve regulated-enterprise deployment confidence.

items.headline: W-7 mission tests cancer medicine microgravity effects
items.summary: V’s W-7 mission page describes an Oct 2026 launch testing microgravity effects on a PROTAC cancer medicine (solubility improvements). Mission progress can de-risk the product pathway.

items.headline: ChatGPT release notes add retail-facing features
items.summary: O’s ChatGPT release notes for October 16, 2026 include new consumer UX (e.g., “Try on” for clothing/accessories). Product iteration can support usage retention and enterprise adoption via improved interfaces.

items.headline: GPT-6 Astra updated rollout
items.summary: O posted an update page for GPT-6 Astra (GPT-6.1 Sol) with the latest release context. This supports continued model deployment and roadmap execution into October.

items.headline: O/partner regulatory filing exhibits reference partnership
items.summary: An SEC-hosted annual report PDF includes language referencing a long-term strategic partnership with O. This is conservative evidence of ongoing enterprise/go-to-market alignment (not new capacity directly).

items.headline: V $251M Series D for orbital pharma processing
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, describing W-Series vehicles and repeatable reentry/data return. The round supports forward capacity and commercialization runway.

items.headline: G deprecates older hosted models
items.summary: G published API/model deprecation documentation, including a September 21, 2026 notice for specific hosted models. Deprecations can be operationally negative for some customers, but also signal ongoing model/service churn.
